name: Misericordia
rules: Coup de grace: vs knocked down enemies ignores armour saves and roll 2D6 taking the highest to-wound roll, causes indescribable pain but does not kill outright
basis: Dagger (uses dagger rules in the Reavers book, S as user -1 like the sheet Dagger) plus the book's coup de grace rule.

name: Ogre club
rules: Extra Stun (Concussion: injury 3-8 counts as stunned), Crushing Attack with both hands: +1 AP and enemy parry Strength counts one higher
basis: Club/Hammer: Concussion mapped to Extra Stun like the sheet Hammer; the two-handed crushing attack gives Mace-level +1 AP.

name: Iron fist
rules: Parry (1), Gloved (occupies the hand, no double-handed weapon), re-roll failed parries if paired with a sword or another iron fist
basis: Buckler-style Parry (1) on a one-handed melee item, priced like a Flail; re-roll rule copied from the book.

name: Harpoon crossbow
rules: Steady Aim (move or shoot), Reload (2), +2 AP, Prepare shot
basis: Crossbow (+1 AP, Reload (2)) with S5 instead of S4 so +1 more AP; Prepare Shot mapped to Reload and Steady Aim.

name: Barbed whip
rules: Cannot be parried, Whipcrack (as steel whip), Enrage: while not in close combat, Warhounds of Chaos within 4" gain +1 attack
basis: No sheet whip; modelled as a plain one-handed User-strength weapon with the book's special rules.

name: Great axe
rules: +4 AP, +1 Crit result, Strike last (unless Strongman)
basis: 2H Axe (+3 AP, +1 Crit, User +2) with the book's extra -1 save modifier as +1 AP, plus strikes last.

name: Throwing axes
rules: Skirmish (no pen move), H2H, Double Shot
basis: Book says treat as Throwing knives, so copied from the sheet Throwing knives.

name: Pike
rules: Strike first (first round even when charged by a spear), Reach 3" (may attack without being in melee, Tileans), only 1 attack, no shield or buckler (Tileans), man-sized or larger targets only (Tileans); Caravans version +1 armour save vs ranged if it carries a shield
basis: Spear (User, Strike first) made two-handed; no AP since it is spear-family not polearm.

name: Staff
rules: Parry (1)
basis: Club-grade price weapon; core-book staff gives Parry, mapped to Parry (1) like a Sword.

name: Cooking Pot Helmet
rules: 9+ stun save, never modified
basis: Helmet (AV 0 with a stun save); printed 5+ converted to 9+ per the group conversion.

name: Kitchen Knife
rules: +1 AP
basis: Dagger priced 2gc; book -1 save modifier is +1 AP; Strength as user rather than the Dagger's -1.

name: Cleaver
rules: +1 AP
basis: Axe/Mace-like one-hander with the book's -1 save modifier as +1 AP.

name: Ladle
rules: Target gets no armour save except shields and skills, Knuckle Cracking: natural 12 to wound makes the enemy drop his weapon
basis: Dagger (User -1); ignoring armour represented in text since no sheet analogue.

name: Tenderiser
rules: Extra Stun
basis: Hammer (Extra Stun) since the book says it stuns on 2-4.

name: Poison daggers
rules: Pair (+1 attack), Black lotus: auto wound on 11+ to-hit, re-applied free after every game
basis: Pair of Daggers with the sheet's Black lotus effect built in.

name: Ball & chain
rules: +3 AP, Random, Cumbersome, Unwieldy (no dual wield, no shield), Incredible Force, only usable under the influence of Mad Cap Mushrooms (Orc Mob goblins)
basis: Flail (+1 AP) scaled up as a 2H weapon at User +2 with +3 AP like other 2H weapons.

name: Double-Barrelled Pistol
rules: Reload (2), +3 AP, H2H, Two barrels: each hit is two blasts, each barrel takes a full turn to reload
basis: Pistol (S4, 10", +3 AP, Reload (2)) with the two-barrel rule.

name: Double-Barrelled Hunting rifle
rules: Steady Aim (move or shoot), Reload (2), +4 AP, Two barrels: each hit is two blasts, each barrel takes a full turn to reload
basis: Long Rifle (S4, 48", +4 AP, Reload (2)) with the two-barrel rule.

name: Boat Hook
rules: Strike first (first round of close combat), no other weapon or shield/buckler
basis: Spear (Strike first) at S -1 and two-handed per the Pirates book.

name: Cat O' Nine Tails
rules: Reach 4", cannot be parried by swords or bucklers, target gets +1 armour save (12 if none)
basis: No sheet whip; one-handed User weapon with the book's reach and save rules.

name: Belaying Pin
rules: Thrown, no range penalties, target gets +1 armour save
basis: Javelin/Throwing weapon with short range per the book.

name: Swivel Gun
rules: Reload (2), +3 AP, no firing twice or after moving, -2 I and -1 M for the wielder; ammo bought per game: Ball Shot 36" S5 +3 AP (Extra Stun), Chain Shot 24" S4 +1 AP (knocked down on 7+), Grape Shot 24" S3 no AP (D6 other enemies within 4" also hit, never hits pirates)
basis: Blackpowder gun modelled on Handgun/Pistol; defaults to Ball Shot (S5, -2 save = +3 AP); ammo profiles in rules.

name: Spiked Gauntlet
rules: +1 AP, Gloved (occupies the hand)
basis: No note in the list and the PDF was not checked; modelled on Mace-grade one-handed weapon.

name: Sigmarite warhammer
rules: Extra Stun (Concussion: injury 3-8 counts as stunned, only 1-2 knocked down), Holy Weapon: +1 to wound vs Possessed or Undead, natural 12 still needed for crits, only Matriarchs and Sister Superiors may carry two
basis: Hammer (Extra Stun) at User +1 as in the book.

name: Weeping Blades
rules: +1 AP, Parry (1), Pair (+1 attack), Venomous: Black lotus permanently (auto wound on 11+ to-hit), no other poison
basis: Pair of Swords: Parry like Sword, Black lotus per the sheet; +1 AP for the poisoned edge.

name: Fighting Claws
rules: +1 AP, Parry (1) with re-roll of a failed parry, Pair (+1 attack), Climb: +2 I for Climbing tests, Cumbersome: no other weapons all battle
basis: Pair of Swords-style Parry (re-roll like sword and buckler); book -1 save modifier is +1 AP.

name: Warplock pistol
rules: Reload (2), +4 AP
basis: Pistol at S5 with the book's -3 save modifier (+4 AP); fires every other turn is Reload (2).

name: Obsidian weapon
rules: Only swords, axes and hammers, -2 I in melee, keeps the base weapon's rules
basis: Applies a flat User +1 to a standard sword/axe/hammer; initiative malus doubled to -2 I.

name: Chaos Dwarf Blunderbuss
rules: Shotgun, Reload (6), Steady Aim (move or shoot), Line shot: 16" x 1" line, every model in it is hit automatically
basis: Blunderbuss (S3, 16", Reload (6)) copied from the sheet.

name: Poisoned daggers
rules: Pair (+1 attack), Swift (+2 I for combat order), Black lotus: auto wound on 11+ to-hit
basis: Pair of Daggers with Black lotus built in; Swift +1 I doubled to +2.

name: Boar Spear
rules: Strike first, Cavalry Bonus (+1 S on the turn a mounted wielder charges), Cross Guard (when charged reduces first assailant's attacks by 1, minimum 1), Unwieldy (no dual wield, shield ok)
basis: Spear (Strike first, Unwieldy) at User +1 with book bonuses.

name: Cathayan Quilted Silk Armor
rules: Stacks with any other armour
basis: Gambeson (AV 1, stacks) since the book adds +1 to saves.

name: Trophy Slann Holy headdress
rules: Saurus Slayer only, stacks with other armour
basis: Small Shield-grade AV 2 since the book gives +2 to armour saves.

name: Nehekharan Javelin
rules: Skirmish (no pen move), +1 to hit
basis: Javelin (User, 8") with the book's +1 to hit.

name: Serpent staff
rules: Parry (1), Serpent: may forgo all normal attacks and parries to have the serpent attack first with one attack at WS4 S4
basis: Staff-like 2H with Parry (1); static serpent profile S4 as printed.
